title: Countable sup-norm-dense families of test forms supported in a relatively compact set
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact (closure W) → ∃ E : Set (TestFormOn U n), E.Countable ∧ (∀ η ∈ E, tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ W) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ W → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ η ∈ E, ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x - (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ ε
